1
Ik Zehar Se Jawad Ke Seene Mein Ghutan Hai.
Baghdad Ke Zindaan Mein Yeh Tasveer-e-Hasan Hai.
Hasil Hai Yeh Shabbir Ke Betay Ko Saholat.
Muhtaj e Kafan Baap Ke Betay Pe Kafan Hai.

2
Pardais Kisay Kehte Hain Pocho Yeh Taqi Se.
Roney Ke Liye Lash Pe Bhai Na Behan Hai.
Sajjad Ki Aoulad Pe Sajjad Ki Ghurbat.
Zindan Ki Dewaron Se Do Saal Sukhan Hai.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ik-zehar-se-jawad-ke-seene-mein-ghutan-hai-lyrics-new-tajpoint-db18fa556a4b115c058a.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numerals in [(roman, '12'), (body, '۱۲')]:
    stanzas = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(stanza) for stanza in stanzas] == [5, 5]
    assert [stanza[0].strip() for stanza in stanzas] == list(numerals)
    assert all(not line.endswith('.') for stanza in stanzas for line in stanza)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified two corresponding four-verse stanzas.')
PY
